statements.t: Our LPAR1 antagonist, PIPE-791, is potentially differentiated in key ways including a favorable safety and tolerability profile, sustained target engagement which we believe has the potential for improved efficacy, and superior convenience in a one-time daily, low oral dose with no titration required for patients.”
